Lines.c6bed6a5-fd27-22f5-756a-c21e14e0ad24: You've got the keyuse it and don't linger on my threshold.
Lines.f72d4914-8802-3ea5-7821-e57e3113b859: Halt. The tavern is closed-no entry for outsiders.
Lines.7426a657-233e-dd47-52f1-f7a47004e7b1: She hasn't blinked in a while. Her grip on the spear eases, then tightens againlike she's reminding herself to stay sharp.
Lines.17fe92c8-51b7-d386-1fc7-510c09911cfb: Fine. But you're Us only if you act like it inside. One wrong word and I drag you out myself.
Lines.4b10999f-5560-976c-ad25-95083f02af78: Hurry. If you're lying, I won't ask questions.
Lines.667a94c7-f7ba-89e1-0acd-01f41e98c509: Absurd. Almost a laugh. Fine. One roundfor me. You slip in, you slip out. Understood?
Lines.c8ed4963-f407-1d02-bd44-9f312418b020: If she's hiding anything, her face doesn't show it.
